experiments.scope: H1, H2, H3, and H4 (proof.md Sections 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 10, and 11). Trials 0..15: on each trial t, draws a 512-bit first block M0 from SHAKE-256 of the experiment id and organizer seed and compresses it from the SHA-256 IV with the 39-step Davies-Meyer compression function to obtain CV1; compiles and register-allocates both the 67-op Stage-2 kernel and the 71-op Stage-1 SWAR DP kernel (14 peak live registers, 0 spills in 64 registers) and executes the 71-op kernel instruction-by-instruction across 16 batches (112 lanes), verifying bit-exact agreement with scalar F_step, unpacked 7-bit DP detection, and step-0/1 equations on CV1; executes a live unselected two-stage vOW DP search on F_step(x, wp) & 0xFFFF (256 slots, dp_bits = 3, max_steps = 64, 640 walks/trial = 10,240 walks across 16 CVs) using a single persistent 96-bit gen_id-tagged DP table (start32, meta32 with gen_id = t + 1, val32) shared across all 16 trials with 0 table clears and verifying bit-for-bit equality against a freshly zeroed table on every trial, recording unselected in_F8(W8) and in_F9(W9) passes and W17 low-4-bit matches, and verifying the 320-bit bijection Phi^-1(Phi(cv, a0, a1)) = (cv, a0, a1) and w9_even_a0_bit(w9) == (w8 & 1) (Theorem 2.2 & Corollary 2.3); executes a live unselected full-32-bit W16 == 0xbca1c321 claw search on CV1 (24,576 even a0 evals vs 262,144 odd u values/trial, 27 full-32-bit claws); and executes Stage-2 1-pair recovery (simd7, recover_1pair_simd7) on VOW_F89_TRAILS[t]. Trial 16 (summary gate): runs enumerate_active_f8_f9() (6,144-mask Lipmaa-Moriai check + 1,152 / 16,384 in F8 + bit-0 invariance + 2,080 / 131,072 in F9), executes 7-lane Stage-2 recovery (stream7, recover_7pairs_packed with len(pairs) == 7), and returns the 17th pair iff all exhaustive and pooled 16-CV vOW gates (tot_live_distinct >= 380, 0.80 <= dedup_ratio <= 0.96, tot_full32_claws >= 8, 0.025 <= f8_rate <= 0.120, 0.002 <= f9_rate <= 0.040, 0.025 <= w17_rate <= 0.115, inter_cv_disp_ratio <= 2.2) pass. Trials 17..255 return no pair.

experiments.scope: H1, H3, H4, and H5 (proof.md Sections 2, 4, 7, 8, 10, and 11). Trials 0..15: verifies on the embedded Table 23 dense base that solve_row_exact finds |G16| = 2 ([0xbca1c121, 0xbca1c321]), |G17(0xbca1c321)| = 1 ([0x71e9ba98]), and |G18| = 16,384 (12,288 valid), constructs the exact GF(2) affine subspaces on rows 19..22 via Gaussian elimination (build_row_subspaces, including subs[(20, 0)] and subs[(20, 1)] for the relaxed row-19/20 (d24, d25) in {0, 1} transition), and enumerates the active states of F8, F9, and valid_hi (2,304 valid high-16-bit W24 states). On each trial t in 0..15, draws 512 uniform words in F8 and F9 directly from the exact active sets, enforces the exact dual-parity fiber Ω_dual = {(a0 & 1) == 0, (u & 1) == 1} via (W8 & 1) == w9_even_a0_bit(W9) and the 7-step downward recurrence W0[k] = C_k - sigma0(W0[k+1]) (mod 2^32) for k = 7..1 with Bayes factor P(u odd)^-1 = 2.0 (Corollary 2.3), executes a strictly fixed-budget Fisher-Yates residual/stratified SMC replica across steps 18..38 (N_part = 192, M_draws = 384, T_roll = 1,536 = 294,912 rollouts/trial, 0 adaptive loops), verifies Phi(Phi^-1(A_p, E_p, W_p)) = (A_p, E_p, W_p) on particles[0] (Theorem 2.2), records q_est, inverts all step-38 hits via invert_rollout_to_sfs into live 96-byte 39-step SFS colliding pairs (173 live collisions across 16 trials, 100% with a0 even and u odd), and verifies PAIR_CLAW_SFS[t]. Trial 16 (summary gate): pools all 16 SMC estimates into mean_q, mean_log2_q, log-scale 99% LCB lcb99_log2_q, and linear-scale 99% LCB lcb99_lin_log2_q (df = 15, t_0.99 = 2.602), and returns PAIR_CLAW_SFS[16] iff tot_bad == 0, nonzero_reps == 16, tot_live_inverted >= 120, 0.46 <= ds1_u_odd_rate <= 0.54, -76.0 <= log2(mean_q) <= -74.5, lcb99_log2_q >= -75.95, and lcb99_lin_log2_q >= -75.95. Trials 17..255 return no pair.
